function.name: search_web
function.description: Perform a keyword search on the internet and get a list of results. Use it when you want to look into something, need up-to-date information, or need to answer the user accurately.

function.name: read_webpage
function.description: Access the webpage at the given URL and get its body text. Use it to read an interesting article from search results or to check the contents of a URL the user shared.

url.description: URL of the webpage to read
